descriptionEn: Apartment for sale with an area of 60m², located on Rruga Eqrem Çabej, within the Hira Residence complex, built by ACE Group.
The apartment is in a practical location for everyday living, with easy access to services and main roads in Fushë Kosovë.

The space is well organised and consists of a living room, a separate kitchen with access to a terrace, one bedroom, one bathroom and a functional hallway. The furnishing is careful and makes the apartment ready to live in without the need for additional investment.
An important advantage is that the property has a storage room in the basement with an area of 3.4m², as well as an ownership certificate, making the purchase process clearer and more secure.
The price of the property is €55,000.
